title: A Grid Expert Advisor Based on a Cellular Automaton with Online Learning in MQL5 (Part II): A New Level of Online Adaptation

for: ApplyFeatureGraphLayer() suppresses isolated outliers by blending each feature with local and small-world neighbors using fixed weights (0.70, 0.20, 0.10) and tanh activation — this is a deterministic, reproducible filter

GraphCoherence(i) computes the average sign agreement between a cell and all 8 graph neighbors (4 geometric + 4 semantic), producing a bounded metric [-1, +1] that can be calculated on historical tick/bar data
GetGraphHealth() returns the average of MathMax(0.0, GraphCoherence(i)) across all 10,000 cells — a scalar time-series metric updated per bar, directly comparable to Network Health over history

The feature grouping (e.g., feat[0..4] = momentum, feat[10..14] = volatility) and semantic connection rules (e.g., 'Momentum ↔ Volatility, Volume, Hurst') define testable logical constraints on co-movement — deviations from expected coherence can be backtested

Practical thresholds are given: Graph Health < 0.20 → 'do not increase confidence; increase grid_step', and Graph Health > 0.45 → 'Confidence can be increased' — these are explicit, falsifiable decision rules

against: The article does not specify any concrete, unambiguous trading signal — i.e., a precise condition (e.g., 'if vote > 0.75 then buy') that triggers an entry. Instead, it describes architectural enhancements (graph-based feature diffusion, semantic neighbors, coherence-weighted voting) but never defines the actual rule that maps the final 'vote' output to a trade decision (entry/exit direction, timing, or position sizing). The only reference is 'double vote = g_ca.PredictNextMove(_Symbol);' — but PredictNextMove() is not defined in the text, nor are its output semantics (e.g., is vote > 0 a long signal? Is it thresholded? Is it used directly as a continuous control? No formula or logic is given.)

The system is explicitly described as a 'Grid Expert Advisor' in the title and context, and the text repeatedly references 'grid_step', 'increase grid_step' in alarm conditions, and 'reduction in false signals' in the context of grid trading — yet no grid-specific logic (e.g., fixed price intervals, pending orders at levels, lot scaling on drawdown, recovery on reversal) is described. The entire article focuses on CA voting and graph coherence, not grid mechanics — meaning the core trading methodology (grid) is absent from the specification.

The article relies on features that are unavailable in standard spot Forex: 'volume' (spot FX has no real volume — only tick volume, which is not traded volume), 'Bollinger Bands position' (requires Bollinger calculation, which is fine), but more critically 'fractal time-series memory', 'Hurst exponent', 'autocorrelation', and 'spectral filtering' — all of which require multi-bar historical series and non-trivial computation; while computable in MQL5, the article gives no indication these are robustly available for all symbols/timeframes in live spot FX (e.g., Hurst exponent requires ≥100+ bars of clean OHLC and fails on low-liquidity or interpolated data), and treats them as first-class, noise-free inputs — violating assumption (3).
non_fatal: No accounting for spread or commission in performance claims (e.g., Sharpe >15).
No description of stop-loss or take-profit logic — only 'grid' is named, but not implemented.
No specification of timeframe or symbol dependency — all logic assumes availability of 50 features uniformly, which may not hold across instruments.

judge.reject_reason: Статья описывает архитектурные улучшения (граф-фильтрацию признаков, семантические связи клеток, когерентность голосования), но не содержит чёткого, детерминированного правила входа: нет указанного порога, условия или логики, преобразующей выход функции PredictNextMove() в конкретное торговое решение (long/short). Функция PredictNextMove() не определена в тексте, её выходной формат и семантика (например, является ли значение >0 сигналом на покупку) не описаны. Также отсутствует любое описание механизма входа, характерного для названия — grid-торговли: нет фиксированных ценовых интервалов, ордеров по уровням, масштабирования лотов, стопов или сетки. Таким образом, невозможно составить полное, детерминированное правило входа для проверки на закрытых барах спот-форекса.
judge.summary: Статья представляет граф-усовершенствованную архитектуру клеточного автомата для адаптивной обработки 50 рыночных признаков и голосования агентов с учётом топологической когерентности. Однако она не определяет конкретное торговое правило: отсутствует описание, как именно выход системы преобразуется в сигналы long/short, и нет реализации заявленной в названии grid-торговли.
